heading: Graduate and Postgraduate Student Felicitation Ceremony-2025
description: On behalf of the above festival committee, under the educational initiative, a felicitation ceremony has been organized to encourage member students of the division who achieved special excellence in the annual college examinations during the academic year 2024-2025. All members are requested to take note and click the button below to view the list of award-winning students.
tagline: A moment of pride, a celebration of joy
next: Click the button below or download to see the list of award-winning meritorious students.
